nodes.label: Discrete Confidence Score Rubric
nodes.rationale: Models follow discrete rubrics better than continuous ranges; production showed guidance collapsing to a bimodal split (>50% at 0.5, >40% at 0.85+), so INFERRED edges must pick one of five fixed values (0.95/0.85/0.75/0.65/0.55) instead of a free continuous score, or be marked AMBIGUOUS.

nodes.label: Manifest Stamping Only On Success (#2015/#1948/#1908/#1417)
nodes.rationale: Only semantic files (docs/papers/images) that actually produced output this run are stamped in the manifest; a changed file whose chunk failed or was omitted must stay unstamped (and have any stale semantic_hash cleared) so the next --update re-queues it instead of marking it done and losing its content forever.

nodes.label: Shrink-Guard (#479)
nodes.rationale: to_json() refuses to write graph.json when the new graph has fewer nodes than the existing one, so an empty or failed extraction can never silently clobber a good graph; GRAPH_REPORT.md and the analysis sidecar are only regenerated when the write actually succeeds.

nodes.norm_label: optional ending: null sanctum / null sovereign

nodes.label: Split Co-op Authority Model
nodes.rationale: The host owns the world (arena seed, director, enemies, bosses, chests, beacon); every player owns themselves (position, items, gold, level, pets). A client resolves its own hits locally and reports the number to the host; the host sends raw incoming damage and the client's own machine applies its armour/barrier/items, so a build is only ever evaluated where it lives. Trusting peers is deliberate: this is a game hosted for friends off a code read aloud.

nodes.label: Never Toggle visible on a Light
nodes.community_name: Performance: Shader Programs, Effect Pools, Broadphase
nodes.norm_label: never toggle visible on a light
nodes.rationale: three.js bakes the visible light count into every material's shader, so toggling a PointLight's visible property recompiles every material in the scene; explosions did this several times a second and program count passed 110, costing hundreds of ms per frame. Fix: allocate lights once and animate intensity to zero instead of toggling visibility.

nodes.label: Honesty Rules
nodes.rationale: Never invent an edge (use AMBIGUOUS if unsure); never skip the corpus check warning; always show token cost in the report; never hide cohesion scores behind symbols; never run HTML viz on a graph with more than 5,000 nodes without warning the user.

nodes.label: Test-Harness Lessons (harnesses lie, measure before optimizing)
nodes.norm_label: test-harness lessons (harnesses lie, measure before optimizing)
nodes.rationale: A 'grapple does nothing' result was actually the test harness holding a key for two frames and firing twice; a scary damage number was two overlapping floating combat-text instances; an FPS complaint traced to shader recompilation, not geometry — underscoring 'measure before optimising'.

nodes.label: Object3D.add Returns Parent, Not Child
nodes.rationale: head.add(mesh).position.set(...) reads like it positions the mesh, but Object3D.add returns the parent, so the line relocated the whole head to the antenna tip's coordinates, placing it inside the torso — the character appeared to have no head.

nodes.label: Debounce (3s default)
nodes.rationale: Waits until file activity stops before triggering a rebuild, so a wave of parallel agent writes doesn't trigger one rebuild per file.

nodes.label: Constrained Query Vocabulary Expansion
nodes.rationale: graphify query matches via case-folded substring + IDF with no stemming, synonyms, or cross-language match; if the question's wording differs from the graph's node-label vocabulary the literal matcher returns 0 hits, so the question must be expanded against the graph's own extracted vocabulary tokens before traversal, never inventing tokens absent from the graph.
